title: Some will say “Lord, Lord” —
paragraphs:
Some will say “Lord, Lord” —
and still hear “I never knew you.”

Not because they lacked power.
Not because they lacked platform.
But because they lacked relationship.

You can preach… and not pray.
Cast out demons… and not crucify pride.
Move in gifts… and not walk in obedience.

Jesus never said, “I never saw your works.”
He said, “I never knew you.”

The issue isn’t activity.
It’s intimacy.
What does “I never knew you” mean?

In Scripture, “know” is covenant language.
Not awareness — relationship.

They used His name.
But they never yielded to His lordship.
Can someone serve in ministry and still be lost?

Judas did.
Gifts are not proof of salvation.
Fruit is.

The scariest deception isn’t pretending to know Him.
It’s thinking He knows you — when He doesn’t.

Search me, Lord.
Don’t let me serve You publicly and miss You privately.
